component.name: OmniLauncher
component.summary: Unified game launcher for Steam and Heroic (GOG/Epic/Amazon)

description.p: OmniLauncher brings your Steam, GOG, Epic, and Amazon Games libraries together in a single, gamepad-friendly interface. It wraps your existing Steam installation directly and uses Heroic Games Launcher's bundled backends (legendary, gogdl, nile) to install and launch games from other stores, so it works alongside tools you may already have installed without duplicating them.
